 Mandi, Ujjain (Madhya Pradesh)

(BY SHRI PRANAY JOSHI - PANEL LAWYER)

This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER 1.

This is the 2nd application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.828/2022 registered at Police Station Chimanganj Mandi, Ujjain for the offence under Section 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant contended that applicant's earlier bail application was dismissed on merit vide order dated 8.5.2023 passed in MCRC No.19337/2023.
After rejecting the earlier bail application, concerned Bank has accepted that due to the Bank's mistake the said amount was transferred into the another account.
The Hon'ble Apex Court has held that on the basis of the criminal antecedent, bail cannot be denied.
Applicant is suffering jail incarceration since 24.12.2022.
Hence, he prays that applicant be released on bail.

sentences.text: Per-contra, learned PL for respondent/State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection by submitting that this Court has already considered all the facts and circumstances of the case and dismissed the earlier bail application by a detailed order, therefore, this repeated bail application cannot be considered.
5. Perused the case diary as well as the impugned order of the court below.

6. Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties as also taking note of the fact that this Court has passed the earlier order only two months back on 8.5.2023 and after considering all the facts and circumstances of the case and evidence available on record, this Court has rejected the earlier bail application on merit, thereafter there is no material changes in the circumstances and the grounds taken by the applicant have already been considered in the earlier order, therefore, this repeated bail application is rejected.
C.C. as per rules

.
